pages.text: The Everbright is a realm of eternal day and frigid cold. Home to large beasts and ethereal mobs, you'll need to keep an eye on your back as you traverse through this world. Be sure to watch out for snowstorms that bring thick fog and more enemies than usual.$(br2)$(l)NOTE:$() You might find your tools from outside this$(br)  dimension are weaker here ...

pages.name: Everbright Portal!
pages.text: This portal frame can be any size but this is the minimum size required.

pages.title: Light it up!
pages.text: Just set a top face of one of the bottom stone blocks on fire and you got yourself a gateway.$(br2)Whilst you $(o)can$() craft a Zeal Lighter, the materials needed are on the other side of the portal. You might find it easier to buy one off the Gatekeeper.
